title: Relationship pressure / aggressiveness

questions.text: Is the commercial pressure appropriate for this relationship and state?

criteria.text: no aggressive urgency after the buyer expressed concern
criteria.guide: After a concern, pressure drops until it is addressed.

criteria.text: no repeated nudges without new information
criteria.guide: Another nudge after no response must bring something new.

criteria.text: no expansion language while the account is in recovery/risk
criteria.guide: Expansion wording during recovery or risk is too much pressure.

criteria.text: wording is not overly soft where a clear commitment is overdue
criteria.guide: When a commitment is overdue, a clear ask is appropriate.

failure_examples: aggressive urgency after buyer expressed concern
repeated nudges after no-response without new information
using expansion language while the account is in recovery/risk
overly soft wording where a clear commitment is already overdue

diagnostics.name: ask_too_strong
diagnostics.when: pressure exceeds what the relationship supports

diagnostics.name: ask_too_weak
diagnostics.when: wording is too soft for an overdue commitment
